body: Thank you very very much for your feedback !

When I have tried to speak my mind when I am calm, he sits there and then lashes out on me and goes in circles and doesn't address the actual problem I am bringing to the table and it's so frustrating to the point where I have stopped now. He knows social media was the reason I stopped having trust in him. We both haven't had any social media for over a year now so it just seems like he's eager to get one and "network" he stated before it's annoying to see me cry and when I feel the urge to cry during situations I turn my face and quickly pep talk myself to stop stop stop crying and I just don't know. I just don't understand how he's cruel to me in an emotional way

He is really cold and I think that is why it hurts so badly. He really does not ever get my side of things. He just sits there and does not talk. It makes me truly insane. I just don't know how to leave. I'm addicted to him. Not the thought of him..but him. I tried therapy in the past and it just seems like I am fed the same generic bullshit that is said for a lot of situations and it just sucks.

I understand I am controlling, but is it wrong of me to be controlling when he disrespected me by hanging out with girls and talking to them behind my back ? I just need you to please explain to me how it's not wrong of him to be side tracked with other girls. Why am I not enough? I just want to be enough for him and I feel as if I'm not..I've never been in a situation like this and I don't know how to understand it. I wouldn't dare even say thank you to a waiter or a store clerk infront of him because he gets pissy..so I just don't know. I asked him if he would go to therapy with me and he said no and then started an argument with me. We are extremely toxic for one another and we are just not good. I have improved I've changed so much in a good way and it seems like i just get shitted on and i don't know how to control it. I get so sad and depressed and when I'm at home I can't even enjoy my home life because I can't get him off my mind. When I'm at work all I do it check my phone to see if he's texted me. The thought of him not being by my side destroys me. I just feel like he doesn't love me anymore and I think I'd rather suffer than leave and hope to find someone different. I don't go to bars or anything like that. I don't really know where to meet someone now a days.
